operators.name: batch_norm_eval_2d

parameters.name: x
parameters.layout: contiguous or channels_last; kernel handles strides

returns.shape: same as x [N, C, H, W]

semantics: Computes eval-mode BatchNorm2d: y = (x - running_mean[c]) / sqrt(running_var[c] + eps) * weight[c] + bias[c]
Normalization is per-channel c, applied to all spatial positions and batch elements
Input x can have arbitrary strides; kernel uses linear index and computes channel via (index / (H*W)) % C
All parameters and running stats must be contiguous; output tensor has same shape as x and is allocated contiguous
No training statistics update in eval mode

operators.name: gelu_erf
semantics: Computes exact GELU: y = x * 0.5 * (1 + erf(x / sqrt(2)))
Elementwise operation, preserves shape and dtype
Input must be contiguous; output is allocated contiguous
BatchNorm2d in eval mode: per-channel affine transform using running_mean and running_var
Input [2560,3,32,32] float32 CUDA; output same shape and device
bn.weight, bn.bias, bn.running_mean, bn.running_var from state_dict
GELU with approximate='none': elementwise erf formula
Input [2560,3,32,32] float32 CUDA; output same shape and device
